about.heroP1: Ntitwubaka urubuga rwo gutwara abantu gusa. Turimo kubaka urusobe rw'ikoranabuhanga rushingiye ku bantu, ruhuza abantu ku giti cyabo, ubucuruzi n'imiryango binyuze mu ngendo, mu bwikorezi no mu bisubizo bya digitale.
about.heroP2: Imbuga zacu zateguwe kugira ngo serivisi za buri munsi ziboneke byoroshye, ku giciro cyiza kandi mu buryo bunyuranye, mu gihe zinafungura amahirwe yo kwinjiza arambye ku bantu babarirwa muri za miliyoni.
about.beliefLead: Buri gicuruzwa twubaka kiyoborwa n'ihame rimwe ryoroshye:
about.beliefHighlight: Ikoranabuhanga rigomba guhanga amahirwe, ntiribe imbogamizi.
about.purposeBody: Gukorera abantu, guha imbaraga imiryango no guhanga amahirwe.

visionParts.text: Kuba urusobe rw'ingendo, ubwikorezi n'ikoranabuhanga rushingiye ku bantu rwizewe kurusha izindi ku isi, duhuza abakoresha barenga
kubona amahirwe yo kwinjiza arambye muri Afurika no hanze yayo.

about.missionBody: Inshingano yacu ni uguhindura uburyo abantu bagenda, bakora kandi bahuza, dutanga ibisubizo binyuranye by'ingendo, ubwikorezi n'ikoranabuhanga bishyira ububasha bwo gufata ibyemezo mu maboko y'abatanga serivisi, mu gihe abakiriya bahabwa agaciro kadasanzwe, umutekano, uburyo bworoshye n'amahitamo.
commitments: Guhanga imirimo n'amahirwe yo kwinjiza birenga miliyoni 5.
Gukorera abakoresha barenga miliyoni 500 ku isi.
Kubaka ikoranabuhanga rifasha bose kugera ku bukungu.
Gushyigikira ba rwiyemezamirimo n'ubucuruzi bwo mu karere.
Gutuma ingendo n'ubwikorezi biboneka, bihendutse kandi byizewe kuri bose.

faq.heading: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
faq.introPrefix: Ibyo ukeneye kumenya byose ku ngendo, gutwara, kwishyura no kugendera mu mutekano na Rides. Ntabwo ubonye igisubizo?

items.a: Rides ni porogaramu imwe ikoreshwa mu buryo bwose bwo kugenda. Moto iyo watinze. Imodoka iyo bikenewe. Hilux ku muhanda mubi. Fuso iyo wimuka. Uhitamo ikinyabiziga, ukabona igiciro mbere yo gutumiza, ukanakurikira umushoferi urugendo rwose.
Injira ukoresheje numero ya telefoni yawe, uhitemo ikinyabiziga, wandike aho uva n'aho ujya, hanyuma wemeze. Umushoferi uri hafi yemera mu masegonda make — hanyuma ukamureba aje ku ikarita.

Ni bune. Moto ku rugendo rwihuse rw'umuntu umwe. Imodoka iyo ushaka kwisanzura. Hilux ku mizigo minini no ku mihanda mibi. Fuso ku mizigo yuzuye. Igiciro kijyana n'icyo wahisemo, ku buryo utigera wishyura ikinyabiziga kirenze icyo urugendo rukeneye.

Bishingira ku ntera, ubwoko bw'ikinyabiziga, n'igihe cy'umunsi — kandi ubona umubare mbere yo gutumiza. Ibiciro kandi bishobora kunganirwa mbere muri porogaramu, haba ku bagenzi cyangwa ku bashoferi. Nta biciro byiyongera. Nta mafaranga ahishe.
MTN Mobile Money cyangwa Airtel Money, uhereye muri porogaramu. Uhisemo amafaranga mu ntoki? Ishyura umushoferi ubwe — igiciro kiba kimwe.

Buri mushoferi atanga indangamuntu ye, ubwishingizi bw'ikinyabiziga, n'icyemezo cyo gutwara abagenzi mbere yo gukora urugendo na rumwe. Itsinda ryacu risuzuma kandi rikemeza buri busabe ku giti cyabwo — nta muntu wiyandikisha ubwe gutyo.

Ushobora guhagarika igihe cyose mbere y'uko umushoferi agera. Nuhagarika kenshi umushoferi asanzwe ari mu nzira, uzatinda gato mbere yo kongera gutumiza — ibyo ni ugukingira abashoferi, kuko banga izindi ngendo kugira ngo bagere aho uri.
Kanda Abashoferi muri menu utangire gusaba. Uzakenera uruhushya rwemewe, ubwishingizi bw'ikinyabiziga, n'icyemezo cy'isuzuma ry'ikinyabiziga. Kwemererwa bisanzwe bifata amasaha 24 kugeza kuri 48.

reply:
Muraho! Murakaza neza kuri Rides.

Ndi umufasha wawe w'ikoranabuhanga — mbaza icyo ushaka cyose ku gutumiza ingendo, kuba umushoferi, kwishyura, cyangwa uko Rides ikorera mu Rwanda.
Byiza cyane — abashoferi ni bo batuma Rides ikura. Dore ibyo ukeneye:

• Uruhushya rwo gutwara rwemewe mu Rwanda
• Ikinyabiziga (Moto, Imodoka, Hilux, cyangwa Fuso)
• Ubwishingizi bwa SONARWA + uruhushya rwa Polisi
• MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money yo kwishyurirwaho
Andika amakuru yawe ku ifishi yo kutwandikira — tuba dusubiza mu masaha 48.
Rides ni yo rubuga rwonyine mu Rwanda aho umugenzi n'umushoferi bumvikana ku giciro bombi.

1. Umugenzi abona igiciro cyagenwe hanyuma agatanga icyo asaba
2. Umushoferi yemera, agasubiza ikindi giciro, cyangwa akarenga
3. Kugeza ku mikino 4 — hanyuma bombi bakumvikana cyangwa bagatandukana
Impuzandengo y'izamuka ku giciro cya mbere ni hafi 18%. Buri giciro kirandikwa.
Dukorera mu Mujyi wa Kigali wose — Gasabo, Kicukiro, na Nyarugenge.
Musanze iri mu igerageza, naho Huye izatangira mu gihembwe cya gatatu cy'2026.
Urashaka Rides mu karere kawe? Tubimenyeshe 👇
Twakira MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, n'amafaranga mu ntoki kuri buri rugendo.
Abashoferi bishyurwa kabiri ku munsi — saa moya za mu gitondo na saa kumi n'imwe z'umugoroba — bikajya kuri konti yabo. Rides ifata 12–18% bitewe n'ikinyabiziga.
Ubwishyu bwose bushobora kugenzurwa muri porogaramu y'umushoferi.
Tubabajwe n'ibyo. Ibibazo by'ingendo tubiha umwanya wa mbere — impuzandengo yo gusubiza ni munsi y'amasaha 12.
Andika ibisobanuro ku ifishi yo kutwandikira mu cyiciro cya 'Ikirego'.
Tubabajwe n'ibyo. Uburyo bwihuse bwo kubona ubufasha ni ifishi yo kutwandikira — impuzandengo yo gusubiza ni munsi y'amasaha 12.
Cyangwa uduhamagare ako kanya kuri WhatsApp:
Urashaka kuvugana n'umuntu nyawe? Dore uburyo bwihuse:
WhatsApp ni yo yihuta mu masaha y'akazi (Mbe–Gtd · 08:00–20:00). Ifishi yo kutwandikira ni nziza ku bintu bikeneye inyandiko isigara.

Sinumva neza icyo ushaka kuvuga.

Gerageza kumbaza ku ngendo, abashoferi, kwishyura, cyangwa uko Rides ikorera mu Rwanda!

content.value: Iyi Politiki y'ibanga yateguwe kugira ngo igufashe gusobanukirwa uko TRAVELIS Rwanda Ltd n'amashami yayo n'ibigo bifitanye isano na yo, harimo na www.rides.rw ("twe", "twebwe" cyangwa "yacu"), dukusanya, dukoresha, dusangiza kandi turinda amakuru yawe bwite igihe ukoresha porogaramu yacu ya telefoni, urubuga rwacu, na serivisi zijyanye na byo. Duha agaciro ibanga ryawe, kandi ntituzasangiza amakuru yawe bwite abandi bantu keretse mu buryo busobanuwe muri iyi Politiki y'ibanga cyangwa wemeye.
Iyo ukoresheje imbuga zacu, uba wemeye uburyo busobanuwe muri iyi politiki. Niba utabyemera, ntukoreshe imbuga zacu, porogaramu zacu za telefoni, kandi ntuduhe amakuru yawe.
Iyi Politiki y'ibanga ireba uko dukusanya, dukoresha kandi dusangiza amakuru yawe bwite:

items: Igihe usuye urubuga rwacu kuri www.rides.rw, izindi mbuga zifitanye isano na rwo, na porogaramu zacu za telefoni
Igihe wakiriye ubutumwa bwacu cyangwa witabiriye ibikorwa cyangwa ibirori byacu, biba kuri interineti cyangwa hanze yayo
Igihe wuzuza ifishi yo kwiyandikisha cyangwa kwiyandikisha kuri porogaramu zacu za telefoni
Amakuru tubona ku bandi bantu nk'abacuruzi, abatanga amakuru abitswe, abatangaza ibirimo n'abatanga serivisi

TRAVELIS Rwanda Ltd ni ikigo cy'ikoranabuhanga gicunga urubuga rwo gutumiza ingendo n'ubwikorezi, ndetse n'ibindi bisubizo na porogaramu bishingiye ku ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda.
Turi ushinzwe amakuru ku makuru bwite akusanyirizwa kuri uru rubuga.

content.value: Abo batanga serivisi bafite politiki zabo z'ibanga, kandi turagusaba kuzisoma.
Cookies ni udufayili duto tw'amakuru dushyirwa ku gikoresho cyawe igihe usuye urubuga. Dukoresha ubwoko butandukanye bwa cookies:

items: Cookies za ngombwa rwose — zikenewe kugira ngo Urubuga rukore, kandi ntizishobora guhagarikwa
Cookies z'imikorere — zidufasha kubara abasuye urubuga n'aho baturutse, kugira ngo dupime kandi dunoze imikorere
Cookies z'imikoreshereze — zituma habaho imikorere yisumbuyeho no guhuza urubuga n'ibyo ukunda
Cookies z'abandi — ziva ku batanga isesengura (urugero Google Analytics), zitanga amakuru ku bwoko bw'abakoresha n'uko bakoresha urubuga

content.value: Dushobora kandi gukoresha web beacons (rimwe na rimwe zitwa "tracking pixels" cyangwa "clear gifs") — udufoto duto twemerera kumenya igihe umuntu yasuye Urubuga rwacu. Niba wiyandikishije kwakira imeyili zacu, dushobora gukoresha cookies muri izo meyili.
Muri za mushakisha nyinshi ushobora gusiba cyangwa kwanga cookies. Kugira ngo ubikore, kurikiza amabwiriza ari mu igenamiterere rya mushakisha yawe.
